title.narrative: Strengthening resilience of vulnerable population through provision of WASH and related Nutrition services in Pulka, Gwoza LGA, of Borno State

Other activities include rehabilitation of 1 Solid lt/spangtlt/fontgtltfont face="Arial" color="#000000"gtltspan style="font-size: 8.5pt background-color: white"gtWaste Disposal Point and decommissioning of 10 blocks of dilapidated latrines in Camp A and Camp D in Pulka.lt/spangtlt/fontgtlt/spangtltbrgtlt/pgtltp style="" class=""gtltspan style="font-size: 8.5pt font-family: Arial color: black background: white"gtFurthermore, the programme will be accompanied with promoting, culturally appropriate gender-and age-sensitive hygiene messaging, aiming at hygienic behaviour and practices as per sector’s standards through Joint Campaigns, Focused group Discussions (FGDs), house-to-house etc, targeting two (2) IDP Camps, Schools, Health Facilities, CMAM Centre, OTP Sites, SCs, within Pulka Gwoza LGA.lt/spangtltspan style="font-size: 8.5pt font-family: Arial color: black"gt ltspan style="background:white"gtAdditionally, Key WASH NFIs distribution in the location to support hygienic practice. SAM Patients in OTP, SC will be specially targeted with these relevant WASH kits.lt/spangtlt/spangtltbrgtlt/pgtltp style="" class=""gtltspan style="background-color: white color: black font-family: Arial font-size: 8.5pt"gtThe Programme also seek to strengthen livelihood and economic activities in targeted location by providing materials and facilitating Soap Making training exercises to be attended by 50 selected women who will desire and can maintain the capacity to replicate and commercialize their acquired skills.lt/spangtltbrgtlt/pgtltp style="" class=""gt
ltspan style="font-family: Arial color: black background-color: white"gtAs a way to ensure the sustainability of the WASH services, LPF will deploy her innovative “For and With” approach of programme implementation where locals will be recruited trained, and enrolled through out every stage of the programme as a way to pursue sustainability and boast livelihood of the community which will invariably add up to the socio-economic well-being of the community and build resilience amongst members of the community. A Programme Exit Session will be organized at the end of the programme to harmonise and transfer key responsibilities to already trained WASHCOM and community Stakeholders. lt/spangtltspan style="font-family: Arial color: black"gtltbrgt lt/spangtlt/pgtltp style="" class=""gtltspan style="font-family: Arial color: black background-color: white"gtResponding to the WASH needs in Pulka, Gwoza LGA, LPF aims to Mainstream protection and mitigate gender-based violence (GBV) to ensure that access to WASH services takes account of findings from systematic consultations with women and girls and by consolidating the achievements of the previous year’s Cholera response in Pulka.ltbrgtlt/spangtlt/pgt
